title: Confirm the shared Engram task-sync rule (Greg: teams sync as they see fit; a code push includes the engram-data push), with Kimi and both coordinators
outcome: TermAl and Engram carry one identical task-sync rule. Teams run the routine engram-data sync whenever they judge it useful, without asking each time. A landing push of master is followed by the engram-data sync. The data branch stays separate from code, and nothing here grants any code push.
acceptance: Kimi and both coordinators confirm the scope of the existing 'Task-sync data branch' bullets in TermAl (AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md, Commit and push section) and Engram (AGENTS.md:376-384). The confirmation records whether they are identical and what, if anything, Greg's word adds.

If the text changes, the identical shared wording lands in both repositories under the authority-text procedure: (a) both coordinators concur, (b) Greg is sent the wording and its consequence, and (c) the final-diff audit is recorded. Greg's words are quoted verbatim with their source.
No new gate, no general code-push permission, and no delay to the Comovo sync.
